comparison.objective: Extract and replace an instrument through a loose-walled port without disturbing the port; candidate tunes and locks a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests constrained vertical extraction/insertion with disturbance minimization; candidate tests hex-key insertion, counterholding, collar adjustment, force-limited relocking, and repeated response evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires the ordered instrument swap with limited port displacement; candidate requires two bounded-energy stops and verified lock retention.
comparison.reason: They share careful insertion and stabilization only as generic primitives; the central mechanisms and outcomes differ. No specs or numeric port-displacement threshold are available.
